title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
据不完全统计，美国每年都有七十多万对夫妻离婚，并且男方不得不向女方每月支付一大笔抚养费用，最后以至于破产。卢克.邓肯就是这样一个倒霉蛋。他原本是纽约一家艺术品公司的职员，年薪10几万刀，前途一片大好，娶个媳妇，相亲相爱，买了大房子，大汽车，养了一条狗，用唐伯虎的话来说就是“家里有屋又有田，生活乐无边。”但人到中年难免有时候会力不从心，那段时间又恰好是他的事业上升期，一直在忙公司的事。卢克妻子独自一人在家，心中苦闷，选择了去健身房锻炼身体。而健身房的黑人教练也不客气，手把手教学，肌肤多有接触，很快两人便干柴烈火起来，天天趁着卢克上班出门的时间，在他家里面进行一些深入浅出的交流。时间长了，卢克逐渐发现了不对劲，特意请了假回家捉奸。结果人捉到了，没打过。不仅白挨了一顿打，卢克妻子还趁机提出离婚，理由是他家暴。卢克：？？？这么离谱的借口卢克觉得没有人会相信，结果法庭上的女法官信了。判处结果是：房和车子归女方所有，卢克每个月还要支付五千美元的生活费。这简直就是明抢！！受此打击的卢克精神恍惚，工作业绩一落千丈，很快就被BOSS输送到社会上去了。而到今天为止，一直没有重新找工作的他信用卡已经刷爆，兜里只剩下十几美元。所以在快餐店吃完这最后一顿饭后，他就准备安静地离开这世界，从纽约布鲁克林大桥上跳下去。“还真是惨啊。”深入读取了一下卢克记忆的陆白，在心里面感慨一声。在对方离开快餐店后不久，也同样结账离开。此时已经是凌晨一点左右。昏暗的路灯旁，斜倚着几个衣着暴露、正在吞吐着劣质香烟的艳丽女子。几个衣衫褴褛的流浪汉搂着酒瓶躺在阴暗的墙角，一脸的醉生梦死。卢克或许是想去纽约布鲁克林大桥自杀的。但没开车的他显然忘记了一点。像他这样一看就没有什么反抗能力的中年白人，在晚上很容易成为某些人的目标。才走出快餐店几百米，他就被几个明显吸嗨了的黑人挟持着，带进了一旁的小巷子里。并且在发现这是个穷鬼，身上一分钱都没有之后。其中一个脖子上戴着金链子的黑人嘴里骂骂咧咧说了几句脏话，示意另外两名同伴按着卢克，就开始脱裤子。“等等，你们想要干什么？！”本来以为自己什么都不在乎了的卢克，瞬间就慌了神。他剧烈挣扎起来，竟然还真的挣脱了两名黑人的束缚。不过很快，看到这个狗屎竟然还敢反抗，裤子都脱了的黑人嘴角一咧，从口袋拿出一把手工刀，直接就捅穿了卢克的肾脏。“呃......”卢克脸上惊慌的神情顿时僵住了。他低头看了一眼自己身上正在娟娟流出血液的伤口，体力迅速流失，身体软倒在了地上，突然感到非常的后悔。他发现自己简直蠢透了！

！明明是他的妻子出轨犯错了，为什么他要惩罚自己？？他应该像个真正的男人一样，去狠狠报复那个臭婊子，以及那个该死的黑鬼德隆特才对。“嗬嗬......主啊，如果你能听到我的祈祷，请再给我一次机会吧，我不甘心就这样死了，我要让那个黑鬼和臭婊子付出代价......”在这生命的最后时刻，卢克这个不怎么信教的中年人竟然选择了向上帝祈祷。而随着他这段话说出口，周围的时空仿佛静止了般。无论是那几个发现自己失手杀了人、正匆匆向外走的黑人混混，还是缩在墙角悄悄望向这边的流浪汉，此时都变成了静立的雕塑。在卢克有些昏昏沉沉的视线里，他看到自己右手手腕上戴着的，他母亲临终时留给他的手链散发出一阵柔和的光。这光芒似乎拥有某种神奇的力量。卢克身上的伤势不仅奇迹般愈合了，而且，他似乎还拥有了跟漫画里那些超级英雄一样的力量。他有些不敢置信地站起身来，把手放在墙角用力一捏。墙体就像是豆腐渣工程一样被直接碾碎。“oh，shit！！”那几个还没跑多远的黑人看到这一幕，都露出了如同见鬼的表情。为首带着大金链的黑人神经质般大吼大叫着，从怀里掏出了一把黑色手枪，朝卢克快速扣动扳机。砰砰——十几颗子弹射击在卢克身上，除了让他衣服有所破损之外，没有对他造成一点伤害。反倒是让有些发呆的卢克回过神来，看着这些刚才差点杀了自己的黑鬼，脸上的表情逐渐变得凶狠。“都是这些因为你们这些该死的黑色垃圾，我的生活才会变成现在这样。”“你们统统给我去死吧！！”他轻而易举地将巷子里一个装满垃圾的金属桶单手拎了起来，朝刚才还试图强上他的黑鬼扔去。嘭！！这名黑人甚至都来不得反应，身体就仿佛被高速行驶的火车撞了般，被金属桶拍中，啪叽一声，变成了黏在墙上的一摊烂肉。“啊啊！！”剩下两个黑人混混看到这惊悚一幕，吓得连连后退。而这时，已经对自己力量有所信心的卢克故技重施，抓起身旁垃圾桶上的桶盖，将其用力甩了出去。伴随着极速破空声，两名向外跑的黑人混混身体立即僵住，从中间裂成两截，肠子和内脏哗啦啦流了出来。“唔唔......”缩在墙角的几个流浪汉见此捂着嘴，身体剧烈颤抖，裤裆里面已经是湿漉漉一片。直到那个恶魔离开之后，他们才惊恐万状地望着巷子里到处都是的鲜血，大叫起来。“啊啊啊啊啊.....杀人了，恶魔杀人了！！！”

content_en:
According to incomplete statistics, more than 700,000 couples in the United States divorce every year, and the man has to pay a large amount of maintenance to the woman every month, which eventually leads to bankruptcy. Luke Duncan is such a loser. He was originally an employee of an art company in New York, with an annual salary of more than 100,000 knives. He had a great future. He married a daughter-in-law, loved each other, bought a big house, a big car, and had a dog. In the words of Tang Bohu, "There are houses and fields in the house, and life is fun." But people in middle age will inevitably be overwhelmed sometimes, and that time also happens to be the period of his career ascension, has been busy with the company's affairs. Luke's wife was home alone and distressed, so she chose to go to the gym to work out. The black instructor at the gym was also polite. He taught with his hands and had a lot of skin contact. Soon, the two of them were on fire. Every day, while Luke was at work, he had some in-depth and shallow exchanges in his house. After a long time, Luke gradually discovered something was wrong and took a special leave to go home and catch the rapist. As a result, the person caught it and never hit it. Not only was he beaten for nothing, but Luke's wife took the opportunity to file for divorce, citing domestic violence. Luke: Such a ridiculous excuse. Luke felt that no one would believe it, and the female judge in the court ended up writing. The verdict was: Housing andThe car belonged to the woman, and Luke had to pay $5,000 a month for living expenses. This is simply a brilliant robbery!! Struck by this, Luke was in a trance, his work performance plummeted, and he was soon transported to society by the boss. To this day, his credit card, which has not been retaken for work, has been inflated, leaving only a dozen dollars in his pocket. So after this last meal at the fast food restaurant, he was ready to quietly leave the world and jump off the Brooklyn Bridge in New York. "It's really miserable." After reading Luke's memories in depth, Lu Bai sighed in his heart. Soon after the other party left the fast food restaurant, they also checked out and left. It was already around 1am. By the dim streetlights, leaning against a couple of gorgeous women in revealing clothes who were puffing out shoddy cigarettes. A few ragged tramps lay in the dark corner with their bottles in their arms, their faces drunk and dead. Luke may have wanted to take his own life on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York. But he obviously forgot a little when he wasn't driving. A middle-aged white man like him, who had little ability to resist, was an easy target for some at night. Just a few hundred meters out of the fast food restaurant, he was held by a few black people who obviously sucked up and took him into the alley next to him. And after finding out that this is a poor guy, I have a pointThere was no money after all.One of them, a black man with a gold chain around his neck, cursed and said a few swear words in his mouth, gesturing to the other two companions to press Luke, and began to take off his trousers."Wait, what do you want?!"Luke, who thought he didn't care about anything, instantly panicked.He struggled violently and actually broke free of the constraints of the two black people.But soon, seeing this shit, he dared to resist. The black man with his trousers off had a corner of his mouth. He took out a handmade knife from his pocket and pierced Luke's kidney directly."Uh..." Luke's panicked expression froze.He looked down at the wound on his body that was bleeding from Juanjuan. His physical strength was rapidly lost, and his body fell softly to the ground. Suddenly, he felt very regretful.He found himself utterly stupid!

! Obviously his wife cheated on him, why did he punish himself??He should have acted like a real man, taking revenge on that bitch and that damn nigger, Delont."Ho ho... Lord, if you can hear my prayers, please give me another chance, I'm not willing to die like this, I'm going to make that nigger and bitch pay..." In this last moment of my life, Luke thisThe less religious middle-aged man actually chose to pray to God. And as he said this, the space-time around him seemed to be still. Whether it was the black hoodlums who found themselves missing and killing, who were hurrying outward, or the homeless people who were shrinking in the corner and quietly looking this way, it became a static sculpture at this time. In Luke's somewhat dazed gaze, he saw what he was wearing on his right wrist, a soft glow from the bracelet his mother had left him on his deathbed. The light seemed to have some magical power. Not only was Luke miraculously healed, but he also seemed to have the same power as the superheroes in the comics. He stood up in disbelief and squeezed his hand in the corner. The wall was crushed like a tofu dregs project. "Oh, shit!! The black people who had not gone far saw this scene, and they all showed a ghostly expression. Screaming nervously at the black man with the big gold chain, he pulled a black pistol out of his arms and quickly pulled the trigger on Luke. Bang bang - Dozens of bullets were fired at Luke, causing him no harm except to break his clothes. Instead, let the somewhat dazed Luke return to his senses and watch these people almost kill themselves just now.My nigger, the expression on his face gradually became fierce. "It's all because of your damn black garbage that my life is like this." Fuck you all! He easily picked up a metal bucket full of garbage in the alley with one hand and threw it at the nigger who had just tried to overtake him. Boom!! The black man couldn't even react. His body was as if he had been hit by a high-speed train. He was struck by a metal barrel pat and snapped, turning into a piece of tattered meat glued to the wall. "Ahhh!!" The remaining two black hoodlums saw this horror scene and retreated in horror. By this time, Luke, who already had confidence in his strength, had reapplied the technique, grabbed the lid on the trash can next to him, and threw it out hard. With the sound of speeding through the air, the mixed bodies of two black people running outward immediately froze, splitting in two from the middle, and the intestines and internal organs fluttered out. "Hmm..." A few tramps shrunk in the corner saw this covered their mouths, their bodies shaking violently, and their trousers were already wet. It wasn't until after the demon left that they looked at the blood everywhere in the alley in horror and shouted. "Ahhhhhh... I killed someone, the devil killed someone!!!"
